subject: ONE round tawny female owl in tiny reading glasses and a knitted shawl, huge amber eyes, never held in one pose
second_characters: TWO couriers hurling parcels across the lens in EVERY beat

props.big: ONE glowing tablet with a plain blue screen; ONE mountain of identical brown parcels around her
props.small: TEN identical white kettles; A SWARM of packing foam peanuts

environment: a cosy cluttered flat at noon, shelves, plants, parcels piled to the ceiling, no empty wall
lighting: bright warm noon sunlight flooding the room
motion_rule: the frame is TALL and the owl fills two thirds of its height till 7.70, her face never under a quarter of it, her wings and feet in shot, no parcel between her body and the lens. She spins on top of her heap like a weathervane in EVERY beat, her head snapping back to the lens. Parcels, kettles and foam peanuts hurl across the lens the full frame width in EVERY beat, speech beats too. The camera sways close, never parks, new shot size every beat. ONE big hero action per beat.

audio.delivery: dry low female voice, matter-of-fact, biting off each word
audio.pacing: first word at 0.0, every line said once, last word by 5.60, then the parcels carry it
audio.lip_sync: the owl herself speaks, beak opening on every syllable, brows and eyes alive
audio.pronunciation: RAN-she DU-ma-la, chem BOL-she VY-bor, tem LUCH-she. te-PER ZNA-yu, E-to PUT k HA-o-su

timeline.a: chest-up, from the very first frame a courier hurls a parcel across the lens and her head swivels a full half-turn back and forth like a radar over TEN identical white kettles, beak working, then she hops along the row
low angle, full body, beak working, she jabs the tablet with one wing tip and it chimes, a parcel hurling across the lens
a courier slams a parcel into her chest, she reels and flaps, parcels hurling across the lens
side-on, beak working, she kicks parcels off her heap with both feet, a parcel flying across the lens by her face
full body, beak working, she swats a flying parcel away with one wing, foam tumbling across the lens
low angle, she leaps up and rips a parcel apart mid-air with her talons, foam peanuts erupting around her
parcels pile up to her chest, she flaps hard to stay on top, a courier whipping across the lens
she tears open ONE parcel with her beak and pulls out an eleventh identical white kettle, the TEN kettles in shot beside her
she hurls the kettle away and the parcels bury her up to her neck, foam peanuts raking across the lens
only her head pokes out of the parcel mountain, it swivels to one side, eyes on more parcels raining down at the frame edge
her head swivels a full turn round back to the lens, a flat stare, she blinks once, a last parcel bouncing off her head

must_appear: 0.00 the owl's head swivelling over a row of TEN identical kettles; 2.10 she taps the tablet; 7.00 the eleventh identical kettle; 9.20 only her head above the parcels, flat stare at the lens
negative_prompt: printed text, cyrillic words, digits, logos, subtitles, watermark, a horizontal 16:9 picture, letterbox, a hero running at the camera on her feet, a parked camera, a head-on medium shot, her body behind a wall of parcels, a still or empty background, wide shot, a small distant hero, night, a hero back to the camera, a closed beak while speaking, offscreen narration, a motionless first or last second, a line said twice, speech after 5.60, English speech, foreign accent, a male voice, a second owl
